name: Flexur T2
description:
Flexur T2 is a Trautonium-inspired, standalone, immediately fun expressive synthesizer with a high skill ceiling. It's an instrument designed for playing emotional melodies through touch-based control.

The Flexur T2 features two floating touch bars with 15mm semitone pitch spanning 23 semitones, paired with a streamlined per-function knob interface optimized for expressive play. It includes preset, autotune, and mono/poly/arp settings, plus a 6×12 mod matrix with two routing pathways and dedicated intensity sliders.

Generous I/O allows control of both analog and digital synths: audio in/out, TRS MIDI in/out, USB-C MIDI out, 2× expression/gate in, and 4× CV out (pitch, gate, envelope, force). It features a full-sized balanced instrument cable jack for conveniently plugging into mixers, guitar pedals, and amps.
